text:
Alex: billing alert: GPU spend spiked in eu-west1 03:20–03:40 UTC, estimate +$18k. anyone on call?
Maria: looking now. console shows a huge launch wave at 03:23 — ~300 new GPU nodes across 2 zones.
Maria: quick snapshot from autoscaler logs: `policy_applied: [autoscale-gpu, autoscale-gpu-eu-fallback]` — both active in eu-west1. that seems wrong.
Jonathan: that matches my suspicion — i merged a change yesterday that copied the staging autoscaler into prod clusters but forgot to flip `scope: staging` -> `scope: prod`. looks like it created a second autoscaler object rather than updating.
Alex: are those new nodes picking up our reserved commitment tags?
Maria: no. I see `node-pool: gpu-prod` nodes with label `env: prod`, but the duplicated pool came up as `node-pool: gpu-copy-2026` with no `reserved:gpu-prod` tag, so the cloud commitment didn't apply -> on-demand billing.
deploy-bot: Deploy log: removed resource `autoscaler.autoscaling/v1 autoscale-gpu-duplicate-eu` at 03:35 UTC by @Maria.
Maria: runbook actions: cordon & drain rogue nodes, delete duplicate autoscaler, scale down pool to target 200 GPUs. commands I ran:
```
kubectl -n infra get hpa,deployments | grep autoscale-gpu
kubectl -n infra delete -f infra/autoscalers/duplicated-autoscaler-eu.yaml
gcloud compute instances list --filter="labels:gpu-copy-2026" --zones=eu-west1-b,eu-west1-c
```
ops-bot: Cloud billing alert: 120 GPUs billed at on-demand rates in eu-west1 between 03:23 and 03:38 UTC. Reserved coverage: 200 GPUs.
Finance Team: can you confirm numbers? we need chargeback & potential cloud credits request.
Alex: based on node counts we hit ~320 GPUs briefly. reserved covered 200, on-demand ~120 -> rough delta $18k (back-of-envelope).
Jonathan: root cause summary: CI infra-deploy has a rule that auto-applies autoscaler manifests when branch name matches `hotfix/*`. a staging manifest had the autoscaler object and it was reapplied into prod cluster without label normalization. fix: add required labels to autoscaler manifests and add an admission webhook to block autoscalers without `env` and `pool` labels. also will add a guard in CI to not auto-apply HPA/autoscaler objects to prod.
Maria: immediate follow-ups: 1) confirm rogue autoscaler deleted (done), 2) run billing reconciliation with finance (pending), 3) create admission webhook PR, 4) add integration test to infra-deploy to detect duplicate autoscalers.
Alex: tagging @Finance Team for credits request and @eng-sre to do a postmortem. please add timeline to the incident doc. :pray:
Finance Team: starting billing reconciliation — will report on credits/offsets within EOD.
Jonathan: i'll open the CI guard PR now and include the autoscaler label check.
Maria: will run a script to ensure all node pools have `reserved` tag mapping to commitments. script: `./scripts/check_reserved_tags.sh --region eu-west1`
Alex: great, thanks everyone. keeping this thread as primary thread for billing notes and action items.
